goal: A session's `.json` and `runs.tsv` row carry what the session actually cost: `sessionResult` takes the running totals from the last `result` line and adds only the per-turn-group amounts.

The plan-writing instruction tells every plan session and the brief to name `runner.model` on each step, preferring narrow, checkable Haiku steps at `effort: high`, and `docs/project/README.md` no longer offers `advisor` or `subagents`.

success_criteria.criterion: `sessionResult` over a stream with several `result` lines gives the last line's cost: step 11 of week-focus-rows reads 2.09 USD, not 6.44.
success_criteria.check: `node --input-type=module -e "import {sessionResult} from './src/mc/run-plan.js'; import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; console.log(sessionResult(readFileSync(process.env.HOME + '/mc/runner/log/week-focus-rows-20261013T075918Z.jsonl','utf8')).total_cost_usd.toFixed(2))"` in memoro-cli prints `2.09`.

success_criteria.criterion: `canon/roles/_plan-writing.md` asks for `runner.model` on every step with Haiku preferred, and `docs/project/README.md` names neither `advisor` nor `subagents`.
success_criteria.check: `grep -n 'Model per step' canon/roles/_plan-writing.md` finds the bullet; `grep -n -E 'advisor|subagents' docs/project/README.md` finds nothing.
